description: Launch content for uniquestaysusa.com — blog posts, spoke hub pages, social campaigns, and newsletter. Voice: The Wanderer's Postcard Collection. Warm, editorial, slightly literary.

userStories.title: Write hero homepage copy
userStories.description: Compelling hero section copy for the landing page. 150-250 words. Must capture the brand voice instantly.
acceptanceCriteria: Opens with a sensory hook, not a value prop
Includes a soft CTA to explore
userStories.notes: This is the first thing people read. It needs to feel like opening a travel journal, not landing on a startup page.

userStories.title: Write hub page for 'Unique Stays' spoke
userStories.description: 800-1200 word editorial hub page for the primary spoke: treehouses, yurts, geodomes, tiny homes, houseboats. This is the broadest umbrella.
acceptanceCriteria: Editorial tone — reads like a travel essay, not a directory
References at least 3 specific stay types with evocative descriptions
SEO keywords woven naturally (unique stays, treehouse rental, etc.)
Ends with invitation to explore listings
userStories.notes: This is the flagship spoke page. Sets the editorial bar for all others.

userStories.title: Write hub page for 'Work-Friendly Stays' spoke
userStories.description: 600-900 word hub page for remote workers seeking workcation properties with good WiFi and desk space.
acceptanceCriteria: Captures the workcation trend with specific data
Tone shifts slightly — more pragmatic but still warm
Appeals to remote workers who want more than a hotel room
userStories.notes: Work-friendly is the most pragmatic spoke. Still editorial but with more utility.

userStories.title: Write launch blog: 'Why We Built UniqueStaysUSA'
userStories.description: Founder story blog post explaining the 'why' behind the site. Personal, honest, editorial.
acceptanceCriteria: Includes the 'too many boring places' frustration
Ends with invitation, not hard sell
userStories.notes: This is the 'about us' as a blog post. The kind of thing that makes people trust you.

userStories.title: Write blog: 'The 10 Most Extraordinary Treehouses in America'
userStories.description: Curated list blog post with editorial descriptions of 10 real treehouse listings.
acceptanceCriteria: Each treehouse gets 100-150 words of evocative editorial
Specific details — location, what makes it special, who it's for
Each links to a listing page (affiliate URL placeholder)
userStories.notes: High SEO value. Treehouse is the highest search volume unique stay category.

userStories.title: Create launch social media batch
userStories.description: 10 social posts for Twitter/Instagram announcing the site launch. Mix of styles.
acceptanceCriteria: Mix of: sensory hooks, behind-the-scenes, data points, humor, invitation
All in brand voice — warm, editorial, no corporate tone
No exclamation marks, no 'escape the ordinary'
userStories.notes: These need to feel like a traveler posting, not a brand marketing.

userStories.title: Create 'Stay of the Week' social template
userStories.description: Reusable template for weekly 'Stay of the Week' social posts. Should be fill-in-the-blank for future use.
acceptanceCriteria: Works for Twitter thread OR Instagram carousel
Example filled out with a real listing style
userStories.notes: This becomes a repeatable content engine. Get the template right once.

userStories.title: Write launch newsletter
userStories.description: Email newsletter announcing the site. 500-800 words. Needs subject line options.
acceptanceCriteria: Soft CTA — invite to explore, not buy
userStories.notes: The newsletter needs to feel like receiving a postcard, not a marketing email.

userStories.title: Write hub page for 'Pet-Friendly Stays' spoke
userStories.description: 600-900 word hub page for travelers who won't leave their pets behind.
acceptanceCriteria: Warm tone — pet people are emotional about this
Addresses common pain points (pet fees, restrictions)
Highlights what makes a pet-friendly stay genuinely great
userStories.notes: Pet owners are loyal audiences. Get this right and they come back.

userStories.title: Write hub page for 'EV-Ready Stays' spoke
userStories.description: 600-900 word hub page for EV road trippers seeking stays with charging.
userStories.notes: EV is the most nascent spoke but growing fast. Early content = SEO advantage.

userStories.title: Write blog: 'The Workcation Manifesto — Why Your Next Remote Work Week Should Be in a Treehouse'
userStories.description: Thought leadership piece combining work-friendly + unique stays spokes with data.
acceptanceCriteria: Leads with the contrarian angle (work from a treehouse, not a WeWork)
Includes practical tips (WiFi expectations, booking length, etc.)
Positions UniqueStaysUSA as the solution naturally
userStories.notes: This is a flagship SEO piece. Combines two high-value spokes.

userStories.title: Final review and quality audit
userStories.description: Review all content created. Check voice consistency, SEO optimization, and quality. Document learnings.
acceptanceCriteria: Every piece passes the 'Would I publish this under the UniqueStaysUSA name?' test
SEO keywords present in blog and spoke content
userStories.notes: Final gate. Nothing ships that wouldn't make the brand stronger.
